evidence: PubChem CID 11597697 identifies lisdexamfetamine dimesylate, formula C17H33N3O7S2, parent CID 11597698, and component methanesulfonic acid.
US7659253 reports crystalline lisdexamfetamine dimesylate with XRPD peaks, DSC onset around 194.7 C, and single-crystal lattice parameters.
proof_layers.blocker: Accessible patent text gives lattice/spectroscopic evidence but not a redistributable CIF or atom-coordinate table.

evidence: PubChem provides a 3D conformer for parent lisdexamfetamine CID 11597698.
MACE-OFF23 small and AIMNet2 both completed local diagnostic measurements on the parent conformer.
proof_layers.blocker: The dimesylate salt page exposes a 3D conformer of the parent, not a full crystal/salt packing model.
Needs license-compatible crystal atom coordinates and at least one comparison form or experimentally meaningful solid-form endpoint.

next_actions: Search CCDC or patent supplementary files for atom coordinates corresponding to the reported single-crystal structure.
If coordinates are available and license-compatible, reconstruct or import CIF and run MACE/AIMNet/fairchem crystal measurements.
Until then, use PubChem parent conformer measurements only as molecule-level diagnostics, not polymorph ranking evidence.
